android.desc:
Yellow Cab of Columbus is the leading provider of Taxi services in Columbus Ohio.
We are pleased to offer our valued clients the very latest in smartphone booking technology with our free Yellow Cab of Columbus ride application.

Key Features of the Yellow Cab of Columbus application include:
• Book a trip in as few as 2 clicks
• Monitor the progress of your vehicle on a map
• Create a list of favorite addresses and assign a custom name for each
• Review all reservations you have made over the past 30 days
• Provide feedback related to the application and/or service you received
• Call Yellow Cab of Columbus with the push of a button

To begin using the Yellow Cab of Columbus application today:
• Download the free app
• Enter your phone number
• Validate your account (via the notification code you receive)
• Login to the app (Set your name and Email for receipts)
• Enter your pickup address
• Enter your destination address (this allows us to provide an estimated fare amount)
• Book your trip 

On booking a reservation, you will immediately receive a confirmation number, along with an update when your vehicle has been assigned. From here you can monitor the progress of your vehicle as it moves towards your pickup location.

The Yellow Cab of Columbus application retains a history of your previous reservations for expense management and can quickly rebook the same trip with the push of a button. You may also create a list of favorite locations (Home, Work, etc.) to speed the booking process.

Let us know how we can serve you better by providing feedback via the Yellow Cab of Columbus application or calling us at 444-4444.
We look forward to adding many exciting new features to the Yellow Cab of Columbus application in the months ahead, and are always interested in what you have to say!

At least here in Columbus, Yellow Cab does have an app for that: https://itunes.apple.com/us/app/id628065359?mt=8 or https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.apcurium.MK.YellowCabColumbus

With all the crazy laws surrounding taxis and liveries, I wouldn't be surprised if an app like that is illegal in some municipalities.
